title: Studio Membership with Gas Reduction Kiln Access
evidence_sentence: Studio Members can participate in community cone 10 gas reduction firings with clay purchased through LUX and provided glazes.
evidence_quote: Access to participate in community cone 10 gas reduction firings. Cone 10 clay can be purchased through the LUX, glazes are provided.
summary: Monthly membership ($120/month) for independent potters includes access to LUX community gas reduction kiln firings at cone 10 with provided glazes.
how_to_join: Contact Ceramics Center Manager Stacy Larson at stacy@luxcenter.org
